record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, shorten causal pooling from four states to three, retaining the existing 0.8*current_state + 0.2*recent_mean blend. A narrower window may reduce stale-interest smoothing without the regression observed when reducing the pooling weight. Mask padding, use only observed prefixes, and retain final-real-position inference. Keep features, embeddings, causal blocks, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; synchronize readout metadata and the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, shorten causal pooling from four states to three while retaining the 0.8 current-state and 0.2 recent-mean blend. This tests whether a narrower window reduces stale-interest smoothing. Existing padding masks and final-real-position inference remain intact; checkpoint metadata and the embedded predictor check agree.
